capabilities: Publish opted-in notes to a static site
Deploy AWS infrastructure (S3, CloudFront) from Obsidian
Generate stable per-note UIDs and URLs
Open linked notes in stacked side-by-side panes
Extend the Markdown-to-HTML pipeline with parser extensions
disambiguation: Not a commonplace-book or note-taking method plugin; it publishes selected notes as a static website.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.13.1+). No hosted service and no telemetry; AWS usage is billed to the user's own account. Detailed documentation lives on a separate docs site, and the Local publish mechanism is marked experimental.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish a chosen subset of notes as a self-hosted static site where links open in adjacent columns.

relations.evidence: Sites are self-hosted on AWS (S3 + CloudFront)

summary: Publishes a curated subset of a vault as a self-hosted static site on AWS, with stacked panes and stable per-note URLs.
